name: Westfield North County
description: Westfield North County is a premier shopping destination in North San Diego County, offering an exceptional retail experience with world-class brands and dining options. As part of the globally recognized Westfield portfolio, this center provides shoppers with the latest fashion, entertainment, and lifestyle offerings in a modern, enclosed mall environment. With convenient amenities like Smart Parking and click-and-collect services, it combines time-saving technology with an all-day shopping experience.
demographics: Westfield North County serves a diverse North San Diego County trade area with a strong middle to upper-middle income demographic, including families, young professionals, and retirees. The primary visitor base consists of households with median incomes ranging from $70,000 to $120,000, with a mix of Hispanic, Caucasian, and Asian populations reflective of the Escondido and surrounding communities. Shoppers typically range from ages 25-54, with a significant representation of family-oriented consumers seeking both value and quality retail options. The center attracts visitors from a 15-20 mile radius including communities like San Marcos, Vista, and Rancho Bernardo, who appreciate the combination of national retailers and dining experiences in a climate-controlled environment.
summary: A premier regional shopping destination in Escondido featuring global brands, dining, and entertainment in a modern enclosed mall setting.
